protocol.unexpectedPassPolicy: An executable probe that exits 0 makes the register runner fail until the entry is retired with proof.

entries.title: Fresh SQLite scaffold requires an undeclared auth-origin fix
entries.desiredBehavior: A packed SQLite scaffold reaches login using only creator-emitted configuration and instructions.
entries.gap: Needs the shared packed scaffold journey and a bounded login request probe; no source-link substitute is accepted.

entries.title: Dev server stays silent for at least 75 seconds after listen
entries.desiredBehavior: A packed scaffold prints its readiness URL and posture immediately after the server listens.
entries.gap: Needs the packed journey runner's observable listen marker so the probe can distinguish silent output from a server that never listened.

entries.title: CLI help exits 1
entries.desiredBehavior: The packed kovo --help command exits 0, writes usage to stdout, and does not classify help as an error.

entries.title: Bare check with no graph reports OK
entries.desiredBehavior: The packed kovo check command fails closed when an empty consumer has no source graph or explicit artifact.

entries.title: Failed build can leave a plausible graph under dist/.kovo
entries.desiredBehavior: A deliberately failed packed build never promotes its staged graph and leaves the last known-good dist untouched.
entries.gap: Needs a packed app fixture with one successful build followed by a deterministic compiler failure and artifact digest comparison.

entries.title: Fresh-app check is coupled to KV417 trusted-boundary setup
entries.desiredBehavior: A newly packed scaffold completes check without bespoke KV417 classifier setup.
entries.gap: Needs the packed starter and its generated checking scripts preserved as the test input before those scripts are removed.

entries.title: Full 44-component catalog check reaches 4.4-4.8 GiB and OOMs
entries.desiredBehavior: A packed scaffold with all 44 copied components typechecks, checks, and builds under the provisional 2 GiB peak-RSS target.
entries.gap: Needs the full-catalog packed fixture and RSS-enforced runner; devex-budgets.json records the non-binding provisional target.

entries.title: Starter tests import an internal classifier mock
entries.desiredBehavior: Packed starter tests use only the app-public inferred harness and no internal classifier import.
entries.gap: Needs a packed starter file census plus its public test run; scanning the source template alone would not prove the published journey.

entries.title: update-docs reports success after writing placeholder-only content
entries.desiredBehavior: Packed kovo update-docs fails when it cannot produce version-matched substantive local documentation.
entries.gap: Needs an offline packed consumer with the current placeholder path triggered deterministically and its output classified.

entries.title: Opaque trusted-boundary path returns an internal 500
entries.desiredBehavior: The packed scaffold handles the opaque trusted-boundary path without an unexplained internal 500.
entries.gap: Needs a minimized packed request fixture that preserves the opaque boundary and distinguishes the intended diagnostic from an infrastructure failure.
